fusions.name: Heartwood Wedge
fusions.desc: Drives a wedge of heartwood into one enemy for 28 damage that ignores armour, then leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Shedding Bark
fusions.desc: Sheds a layer of bark in every direction, dealing 4 damage to each enemy within 2.5 tiles. You move 12% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Gorse Hauberk
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 60% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it lasts restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Annual Layers
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a layer of bark builds on you, up to 6. At 6 layers they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per layer (42% in all). A layer fades every 10 seconds if none is added. You also regenerate 1 health a second.
